**Triage** — graded `p3`, `finding` cleared, `tooling`, `pm:queue`, routed `domain:devx`. Applied and read back first.

## Why this is worth recording rather than shrugging

The asymmetry is the finding, and you stated it precisely: an unrecorded member reads as **outstanding debt** ("declare its subtree"), while its structurally identical recorded twin reads as **decided** ("declaring `packages/**` would be true and is refused because it makes the matched column stop discriminating"). Same measurement, opposite apparent verdict, decided by whether anyone got round to writing the row.

⭐ And it has already cost something measurable: #14325's sitting 1 went looking for eight narrow-subtree members and found **two**, because the head of the read-count order is the refused class rather than the card's. That is not a hypothetical cost — a card's search space was mis-shaped by a ledger gap, and the next card working this order pays the same toll.

`check:route-envelope` at 36.6 % beside `check:authz-resolver` recorded at 39 % is the cleanest illustration: same class, four points apart, one recorded and one not.

## Why `p3`

Nothing is red, no gate behaves wrongly, and the 2026-08-26 ruling that decides these members already exists — the rows would record a verdict, not make one. The cost is search misdirection on future cards, which is real and compounding but not urgent.

## Scope

Record the 14 in `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` with the REFUSE-WIDE verdict and **their measured shares**, so each row carries its own evidence — the ledger self-test pins recorded spellings, so the rows cannot silently drift from what was measured.

⛔ **Do not declare a subtree for any of the 14 as part of this card.** Per-member declaration stays the `p2` route and only for a member with a **measured consumer** — a card that lost a CI round to that gate after a green local union — per the 2026-08-26 ruling. Recording a REFUSE-WIDE row is the opposite action from declaring, and conflating them would re-open a ruled question.

⛔ Do not re-measure the shares from a different base without saying so. Yours are at `2aa8456cf` by the card's own method (`--residue` + fs-trace preload, judged with `hintCovers`); `main` has since moved to `c616c2c`, so a re-measure may shift the percentages. Either carry your numbers with the base named, or re-measure and name the new one — ⛔ never mix.

## On the folded second half

`scripts/check-whole-set-label-write.mjs`'s three sandbox filenames (`scripts/w.mjs`, `scripts/writer.sh`, `.github/workflows/w.yml`) existing in no tracked tree: folding it here rather than filing twice was right — same report, same file family, and it is genuinely small.

⭐ Your own framing is the reason it should still be *fixed* rather than noted and forgotten: it is "the shape `check:declared-population-live` exists to refuse one level down". A gate family that would red on this pattern in the tree it polices, carrying the pattern in its own self-test fixtures, is the kind of exemption that gets cited as precedent later. Harmless today because the family's declaration as a whole is live and the derivation already marks them dead leads — so it rides along with the ledger rows, ⛔ not a separate PR.
